robust.context: Current mutations.txt and mutation-data.h; player.cc protections, spl-util.cc efficient spell cost floor, ability.cc non-free invocations and ouch.cc blood haste threshold. MP is magic capacity, never fuel consumption; scales are skin plates, never weighing scales. Movement speed does not change attacks/casting. Strong/Clever/Agile include both attribute penalties. Slaying means accuracy and damage for melee/ranged attacks. Helmets are rigid headgear; horns/antennae level three forbid even soft headgear. Poison resistance is not immunity; Clarity prevents involuntary berserk only. Spell cost has minimum 1 MP. Potion duration doubles all granted status effects, not healing. Protean Grace excludes itself and innate mutations, caps at seven and survives form suppression; exact Lua count preserved. Extra vitality adds max HP, not Strength. Double potion healing affects HP/MP restored, not all potion effects. Runic armour relief affects spell success, not armour AC or every penalty. Wind skill selector includes Unarmed for North and only magic schools for East, excluding Spellcasting/Invocations/Evocations. tough skin.context: Current mutations.txt and mutation-data.h; player.cc protections, spl-util.cc efficient spell cost floor, ability.cc non-free invocations and ouch.cc blood haste threshold. MP is magic capacity, never fuel consumption; scales are skin plates, never weighing scales. Movement speed does not change attacks/casting. Strong/Clever/Agile include both attribute penalties. Slaying means accuracy and damage for melee/ranged attacks. Helmets are rigid headgear; horns/antennae level three forbid even soft headgear. Poison resistance is not immunity; Clarity prevents involuntary berserk only. Spell cost has minimum 1 MP. Potion duration doubles all granted status effects, not healing. Protean Grace excludes itself and innate mutations, caps at seven and survives form suppression; exact Lua count preserved. Time-warped Blood triggers at no more than two-thirds HP and resets only after full healing. Names shared by game and wiki.

Slaying means accuracy and damage for melee/ranged attacks. Helmets are rigid headgear; horns/antennae level three forbid even soft headgear. Poison resistance is not immunity; Clarity prevents involuntary berserk only. Spell cost has minimum 1 MP. Potion duration doubles all granted status effects, not healing. Protean Grace excludes itself and innate mutations, caps at seven and survives form suppression; exact Lua count preserved. Time-warped Blood triggers at no more than two-thirds HP and resets only after full healing. Names shared by game and wiki.
